_comment: Bike Share Toronto. Every column is renamed twice across the archive (snake_case -> Title Case -> Title_Snake) and reordered once at 2018. 'Trip  Duration' really does carry two spaces; it is mapped verbatim and must never be trimmed into 'Trip Duration'. Verified across every acquired file by pipeline/census.py.

_eras.2016, 2017-Q3, 2017-Q4: seven columns, station NAMES ONLY - no station ids
_eras.2017-Q1, 2017-Q2: nine columns, ids present, minute-precision M/D/YYYY
_eras.2019-2024: Title Case with the doubled space; adds Bike Id
_eras.2025+: Title_Snake; Bike_Model is the only e-bike signal any Toronto era carries. Present from the re-published 2024 file onward.
_eras.2014-2015: NOT trip data - pre-aggregated OD matrices at a different grain. Excluded from fact_trips; see docs/source-audit.md
